generation.text: Weather patterns are like habits. One of the most common patterns is the rainy season, which happens in many places around the world. When it rains, the sky is dark with clouds and rain falls from them. The rain happens because warm air near the surface of the Earth rises into cooler air higher up. The warm air contains water that turns into tiny droplets of liquid when it cools. These droplets stick together to form clouds. When the clouds get big and heavy, they release the water as rain.
